notablePrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Remve a +1/+1 counter from Deathbringer Thoctar, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
That creature triggers, causing its controller to sacrifice it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.
